reason: The commission problem is real, we pay Booking.com a lot and no-shows hurt. But this is a pretty logo and a website from a studio I have never heard of, and a logo does not fill rooms in low season. I would only look at it if someone showed me the booking numbers first.
objection: I would be paying $800 for a brand, and I still would not know if one extra direct booking comes out of it. Who checks that it works?
would_change_my_mind: A clear before and after on a hotel like mine, with real direct booking numbers and the cost of the deposit and WhatsApp setup written down.
